items.name: github-actions-pipeline
items.title: Github Actions Pipeline
items.description: Design, write, or fix GitHub Actions workflows for a project: a CI pipeline with the right triggers, concurrency, caching, matrix, and least-privilege permissions; pinned actions; reusable workflows and composite actions; deploy workflows with environments and OIDC instead of long-lived secrets; and the debugging moves for slow, flaky, or failing runs. Use when adding CI to a repository, when a pipeline is slow or flaky, when a workflow needs deploy or release steps, or when a security review flags workflow permissions.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
